payload.summary: Implemented the feature under the operator's D9 waiver. Built all packages: vendored pgvector backend (packages/code-search), coordinator service + MCP/HTTP surfaces, and the registry migration + docs. Everything runnable without a live DB/embedder is tested and green (backend 24, service 13, migration 2); E2E paths that need ParadeDB + an embedder are written and skip-marked. CODE_SEARCH_ENABLED stays off by default.
completed_work: wp-vendor-backend: packages/code-search (identifiers, schema, query_pg, indexer_pg, cli, pyproject, tests) — 24 pass / 4 skip
wp-coordinator-service: src/code_search.py + POST /search/code + search_code MCP tool + http_proxy passthrough — 13 pass
wp-integration (partial): CLAUDE.md tool row; E2E + upstream PR deferred

decisions.title: Dependency-injected service so D4/D5/D7/D10 logic is unit-testable without DB/embedder
decisions.rationale: Injected registry/embedder/search backends let the whole service be tested with mocks in the PyPI-only harness; make_pg_backends is the thin raw-SQL wrapper for the live pool

decisions.title: Import-layering: heavy cocoindex/torch confined to indexer_pg (lazy)
decisions.rationale: identifiers/schema/query_pg import with asyncpg only, so the package + query path work without the embedding stack (verified)

decisions.title: MCP tool conditionally registered; HTTP route 404s when flag off
decisions.rationale: Spec requires the tool be absent from the list when disabled; the route returning 404 satisfies the HTTP flag scenario

decisions.title: E2E/migration-apply tests written but skip-marked
decisions.rationale: Honest coverage — the scenarios exist and gate the DB-available env, without faking green in a no-DB session

next_steps: Run /validate-feature where a DB/embedder exists; close D9 via eval 0.2 + task 5.1
Optionally open the upstream cocoindex-code backend-option PR (task 5.3)
